purpose: We want to design a voluntary free screening programme for chronic kidney disease for the general population in cooperation with nephrologists. Nothing here is connected to contracts or tariffs.
question: How many adults have chronic kidney disease, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Report per region: adults with chronic kidney disease.
